messages:
dana: opened PR to update nebula-embed model card: clarify batching vs enforced limits, add small python+go snippets, and note sharded-variant caveats. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024

li: quick read 1: agree we should avoid wording that sounds like a hard SLA for Dedicated. suggest columns: recommended_batch and notes.

chris: added perf numbers from quick run: hosted 8xA10 ~12k items/s (p95 40ms), small-dedicated T4 ~2k items/s (p95 110ms). added sentence: "throughput depends on dim, batching and network."

li: added python async snippet (short):

```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async with AsyncClient() as c:
    resp = await c.embeddings.create(model="nebula-embed-2.1", input=[...], batch_config={"max_batch_size":256})
```

chris: added go sync example and linked /docs/sdk/batching.md.

li: compatibility note for sharded variants: supported hosted, "supported with tuning" for Dedicated; recommend smaller batches.

docs-bot: link-check OK (commit d9f4c).

dana: pushed final edits and merged. closing thread.
